script_text: Stop, Pisces, the sky is handing you a rare lock-in on money, work, and deep desire. Jupiter, your traditional ruler in Leo, moves through your 6th House of routines and forms a strong trine to Saturn in your 2nd House of earned income, while Neptune, your modern ruler, deepens the water element you carry. Venus is also stationing direct in Libra in your 8th House of intimacy, so charged bonds can finally move forward with honesty. For taken Pisces, schedule one honest conversation, not a midnight confrontation; for single Pisces, your calm water energy attracts someone emotionally serious, not a casual fling. In career, use this 6th-to-2nd House trine to tighten budgets, negotiate pay, and turn steady effort into tangible cash and visibility by Friday. Avoid resurrecting old debt or financial secrets until Venus clears its shadow. Follow for tomorrow's Pisces reading.
